_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0% directional success over 35 windows and no coil-breaker signal present (funding flat, MVRV cold, no netflow spike), HOLD is the statistically honest call — a directional bet here is a guess against a 0-for-35 base rate.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly calls HOLD with medium conviction citing the coil; narrative implies accumulation/UP but provides no trigger evidence, only a story
next_move.confirmed_if: MVRV zscore reclaims 35+ with funding sustained above 0.01% and btc_momentum_30d pushing 60+
next_move.invalidated_if: MVRV zscore drops below 18 with VIX spiking above 25 and exchange_netflow above 70
